about: Numbers behind the Strength Index, the muscle map and the streak. Change them here; the app logic reads them at start-up.

strength.about: Each exercise is scored by estimated 1 rep max (Epley) against the first time you logged it. An exercise only detrains when none of its main muscles have been trained for graceDays: trained lifters keep their maximal strength for about 3 weeks off, then lose roughly 7 to 12 percent over the next 2 to 3 months (Bosquet 2013, Mujika & Padilla 2000). It never drops below detrainingFloor times its level. A worse session than usual only pulls the level part of the way down (dipWeight).

projectionMaxWeeklyChange.about: The projection never climbs or falls faster than this share of the index per week. Reported strength gains shrink with experience: about 40 percent for untrained people, 20 percent moderately trained, 16 percent trained and 10 percent advanced, over weeks to 2 years of training (Kraemer 2002, ACSM 2009).

muscles.about: Muscle map: hard sets per muscle over the last week, against weeklyTargetSets. About 10 or more weekly sets per muscle gives more growth than fewer (Schoenfeld 2017). A secondary muscle counts as half a set (fractional sets, Pelland 2024). Sets in the last fullDays count fully, then fade out over fadeDays. Sets for one muscle in one session count up to maxSetsPerSession.

streak.about: The streak stays alive through normal rest: up to maxRestDays in a row without training.
